name: 魔女之塔 Witch's Tower
detailed_description:
"Tower of the Sorcerer" is a strategy-based RPG game. When playing, you need to use your brain to choose the optimal route as much as possible. A wrong decision may lead to the failure of the game.

This work, Witch's Tower, adds rich elements such as map exploration, puzzle-solving, and scene interaction on this basis, making the game strategy more abundant. It also incorporates a plot with suspenseful colors, creating a different gameplay experience of the Tower of the Sorcerer.

In the game, you can change the terrain by cutting trees, building bridges, pushing stones, triggering mechanisms, etc., to create shortcuts and develop more efficient clearance paths.

This work is not confined to the traditional mode of continuously climbing up one Tower of the Sorcerer. Instead, it adopts a three-dimensional exploration form where 4 Tower of the Sorcerers are located in an explorable big world, making exploration and puzzle-solving more layered and immersive.

The game features a multi-ending plot, and your choices may trigger different endings.

You wake up from a dream and find yourself in a graveyard, having lost all your memories.

You are told that you are already dead, and this is the world after death.

In order to find out who you are and why you came here, you must explore the 4 Tower of the Sorcerers in this world and uncover the truth of this world.

Thus, your adventure begins.

This work was developed using the GameCreator engine.

Thank you to the GameCreator team for their technical support!
